Reaching out can feel like a big step. You’re welcome to begin with exactly where you are.

Sunflower Mind is the practice of Nayana Binuraj Antony, an RCI-registered clinical psychologist. It’s a place to explore what brings you here, ask questions about therapy, and consider what support could look like for you.

A LITTLE MORE CLARITY

It’s okay to
have questions.

Do I need to know what to say?+

No perfect explanation is needed to begin. You can start with what feels most important or ask questions about the process.

How do I book a session?+

You can explore the calendar in the appointments section. Online booking and contact details are being prepared. Dates shown are not confirmed availability, and no appointment is reserved.

What are the fees and session options?+

Sessions typically last 60 minutes, with other lengths by arrangement. Session formats and fees will be published before booking opens. No payment is collected through this website at present.

How will my information be handled?+

This website currently has no intake form and does not collect clinical information. Before booking opens, the practice will provide its privacy notice and consent information, including confidentiality and its limits.

Can I get urgent help here?+

This website is not monitored for urgent support. If you or someone else is in immediate danger, contact your local emergency services or go to the nearest emergency department.
